items.summaryZh: 头条新闻： Zcash仍然受到特质催化剂的支持，但宏观逆风限制了进一步的收益。下一步是什么？随着通胀预期上升，欧元区9月份的经济情绪下滑白银仍面临进一步下行风险，因为美伊谈判占据中心舞台澳元/美元面临更大的跌破0.7000的风险，因为澳联储加息未能提振澳大利亚……

items.title: What are the main events for today?
items.summary: EUROPEAN SESSION In the European session, we get the French and German inflation data. The French HICP Y/Y is expected at 3.2% vs 2.6% prior, but the focus will be on the core measure which ticked lower to 1.1% in the prior month.
items.summaryZh: 欧洲会议在欧洲会议上，我们获得法国和德国的通胀数据。法国HICP同比预期为3.2% ，而之前为2.6% ，但重点将放在核心指标上，该指标在上个月跌至1.1%。

items.title: German import prices jump 1.0% in August as cost pressures build
items.summary: Germany August import prices +1.0% vs +0.7% m/m expected Prior +0.2% Germany August import prices +8.3% vs +8.0% y/y expected Prior +6.8% The breakdownImport prices rose another 1.0% on the month in August, pushing the annual rate up sharply to 8.3% from 6.8%. This marks the strongest annual increase since December 2022.
